newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Drilling in deal for deepwater drillships.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Drilling in deal for deepwater drillships.

text.p: Falcon Drilling Co Inc said Thursday it has received letters of intent for multi-year contracts for two deepwater drillships.
The drillships are to be completed and delivered in the the second half of 1998.
The company said potential revenues over the primary contract term for both units total $570 million.

One of the contracts, worth up to $378 million over six years, is with Petroleo Brasiliero. The site of the operation is off the shore of Brazil. The second contract, for three years, is with a consortium of oil companies at a site in the Gulf of Mexico. That contract is worth up to $192 million.
Both commitments, said the company, are subject to the execution of mutually agreed upon drilling contracts.
